_comment: Remote feature gate. 'enabled' is the kill-switch (blocks everyone). 'minVersion'/'minBuild' are the minimum-app-version gate: empty string / 0 = no version gate. The comparison strips the pre-release suffix, so '2.2.19-beta' == '2.2.19' — use minBuild to separate beta builds of the same version. Only clients on 2.2.19-beta build 2265 or newer understand minVersion; older builds ignore it. Raise minVersion ONLY AFTER the target release is live in releases/releases.json. Placeholders for outdatedMessage: {required}, {current}.
